Risk Description: Source data quality may reduce dashboard accuracy
Risk Owner: Profile source data; agree reconciliation thresholds; obtain data-owner sign-off

Risk Description: Business users may request additional KPIs after design sign-off
Risk Owner: Use formal change control and baseline KPI catalogue

Risk Description: ETL performance may be inadequate at peak volumes
Risk Owner: Load test pipelines and optimise refresh windows

Risk Description: Credit bureau API dependency may delay integration
Risk Owner: Daily vendor follow-up; mock service; escalate contract dependency

Risk Description: Late defect discovery may threaten SIT exit
Risk Owner: Daily defect triage; prioritise severity 1 and 2 defects

Risk Description: Underwriting rules may not match approved policy
Risk Owner: Business rule walkthrough and traceability matrix

Risk Description: CRM data mapping may contain duplicate customer records
Risk Owner: Deduplication rules; sample-based validation; business approval

Risk Description: Relationship manager adoption may be lower than expected
Configuration changes may extend UAT preparation
Regulatory report logic may be interpreted inconsistently
Risk Owner: Document definitions and obtain risk-owner approval

Risk Description: Control evidence may be incomplete for audit review
Risk Owner: Maintain evidence repository and control checklist

Risk Description: Key reporting SME availability may be constrained
Risk Owner: Book review slots two weeks in advance; identify deputy

Risk Description: Legacy data quality exceptions may exceed assumptions
Risk Owner: Profile early; agree remediation owners and exception thresholds

Risk Description: Migration rehearsal may fail due to unresolved dependencies
Risk Owner: Dependency log; daily cross-team checkpoint; rollback plan

Risk Description: Cloud environment access approval may be delayed
Risk Owner: Raise access requests early and track with infrastructure lead
